p.title: omp settings
p.lead: Theme, composer, status line and how the transcript renders.

rows.label: Dark Theme
rows.hint: Theme used when the terminal has a dark background

rows.label: Light Theme
rows.hint: Theme used when the terminal has a light background

rows.label: Symbol Preset
rows.hint: Glyph set for icons and symbols (Unicode, Nerd Font, or ASCII)

options.label: Unicode
options.detail: Standard symbols (default)

options.label: Nerd Font
options.detail: Requires a Nerd Font, or a Glyph Protocol terminal (icons ship in-band)

options.label: ASCII
options.detail: Maximum compatibility

rows.label: Color-Blind Mode
rows.hint: Use blue instead of green for diff additions

rows.label: Composer Shape
rows.hint: Visual layout of the input editor and status line

options.label: Status Band (Default)
options.detail: Flush soft-capped status band above a curved prompt, no frame

options.label: Rounded Box
options.detail: Status line embedded in top border, compact 2-line prompt

options.label: Claude Code
options.detail: Full-width horizontal rules above and below, status line at bottom

options.label: Pi
options.detail: Framed horizontal rules with status line at bottom

options.label: Borderless
options.detail: Clean prompt glyph with status line at bottom, no box borders

options.label: Top Rule Dock
options.detail: Single top rule with status docked onto it and below

options.label: Compact Field
options.detail: Filled one-row field with accent end caps

options.label: Accent Rail
options.detail: Filled one-row field anchored by a single accent rail

rows.label: Generation Rate
rows.hint: Show a live generation tok/s readout: on the working row next to the session title, or in the native composer bar right after the thinking level, where the last reading stays between turns. Estimated from streamed deltas and corrected by the provider's billed output count as each message completes.

rows.label: Status Line Preset
rows.hint: Pre-built status line configurations

options.label: Default
options.detail: Model, path, git, context, tokens, cost

options.label: Minimal
options.detail: Path and git only

options.label: Compact
options.detail: Model, git, cost, context

options.label: Full
options.detail: All segments including time

options.label: Nerd
options.detail: Maximum info with Nerd Font icons

options.label: ASCII
options.detail: No special characters

options.label: Custom
options.detail: User-defined segments

rows.label: Status Line Separator
rows.hint: Style of separators between segments

options.label: Powerline
options.detail: Solid arrows (Nerd Font)

options.label: Thin chevron
options.detail: Thin arrows (Nerd Font)

options.label: Slash
options.detail: Forward slashes

options.label: Pipe
options.detail: Vertical pipes

options.label: Block
options.detail: Solid blocks

options.label: None
options.detail: Space only

options.label: ASCII
options.detail: Greater-than signs

rows.label: Context-Reactive Line
rows.hint: How the line between the left and right segments reflects context usage (box composer only)

options.label: Off
options.detail: Solid accent line, no context feedback

options.label: Percentage
options.detail: Used portion in accent color, remainder dimmed

options.label: Annotated
options.detail: Percentage plus ticks at the speculative and auto-compaction boundaries

options.label: Embedded
options.detail: Annotated line with the context percentage and window embedded in the gauge

rows.label: Session Accent
rows.hint: Use the session name color for the editor border and status line gap

rows.label: Transparent Status Line
rows.hint: Use the terminal's default background for the status line instead of the theme's `statusLineBg`. Powerline end caps are dropped because they need a contrasting fill to bridge into the surrounding terminal.

rows.label: Compact Thinking Level
rows.hint: Show the thinking level as a single icon on the model name instead of a separate ` · <level>` suffix; in Tern's composer, as the model chip's icon instead of a separate chip (click the icon to cycle it).

rows.label: Show Hook Status
rows.hint: Display hook status messages below the status line

rows.label: Resize Scrollback
rows.hint: How a settled terminal resize refreshes transcript rows retained in terminal scrollback

options.label: Append
options.detail: Replay the transcript at the new width below retained history

options.label: Rebuild
options.detail: Erase all terminal scrollback, then replay one current-width transcript

options.label: Preserve
options.detail: Repaint only the viewport and keep history wrapped at its old width

rows.label: Complete Scrollback
rows.hint: Send transcript rows pushed off screen by a growing HUD or dialog straight to scrollback; when it shrinks, blank rows sit between the transcript and the input until new output fills them

rows.label: Native Terminal Progress
rows.hint: Emit OSC 9;4 indeterminate progress while the agent or context maintenance is running (always on in Tern)

rows.label: Program Status (OSC 7501)
rows.hint: Report whether the agent is working, waiting on you, done, or failed over OSC 7501, for terminal tab indicators and agent inboxes

rows.label: Large Headings (Kitty)
rows.hint: Render Markdown H1 headings at 2x scale using Kitty's OSC 66 text-sizing protocol. Only takes effect on Kitty terminals; ignored everywhere else. Off by default.

rows.label: Render Mermaid Diagrams
rows.hint: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as ASCII diagrams

rows.label: Render SVG Figures
rows.hint: Invite the agent to draw diagrams and charts as SVG, rendered inline as images on terminals that show graphics

rows.label: Auto-Graph Tables
rows.hint: Draw a chart under numeric tables in the agent's answers, in your theme's colors, on terminals that show graphics

options.label: Smart
options.detail: The judge model refines each chart: kind, columns, row names and grouping, scales, which way is better, and its title

options.label: Always
options.detail: Chart every table that reads as numeric, using the built-in best guess

options.label: Off
options.detail: Leave tables as tables

rows.label: Agent Reactions
rows.hint: Invite the agent to react to your message with an emoji badge on its bubble

rows.label: Codex Reset Fireworks
rows.hint: Celebrate unscheduled Codex weekly usage resets and newly banked saved resets with a top-third fireworks overlay that remains until 󱊷

rows.label: Terminal Title Run State
rows.hint: Show the agent run state in the terminal title's separator — an animated spinner while working (a static ':' under WSL), '>' when it's your turn, '!' when the agent is waiting on you

rows.label: Terminal Title Spinner
rows.hint: Glyph set for the working-state spinner in the terminal title — braille sweep, filling moon, single-dot cycle, or ASCII-safe line

options.label: Braille
options.detail: Classic ⠋⠙⠹ sweep (default)

options.label: Pulse
options.detail: Moon filling ○◑● then emptying

options.label: Dots
options.detail: Single braille dots cycling

options.label: Line
options.detail: ASCII - \ | / for fonts without braille coverage

rows.label: Terminal Hyperlinks
rows.hint: Wrap paths and URLs in OSC 8 hyperlinks for terminal-native click-to-open (auto: detect support; off: never; always: unconditional)

rows.label: Mouse Click-to-Focus
rows.hint: Capture mouse clicks in the main session so live subagent cards and HUD rows focus on click, with a hover highlight on the target. Native text selection becomes 󰘶+drag and wheel scroll becomes 󰘶+wheel while on

rows.label: Tight Layout
rows.hint: Remove the 1-character horizontal padding from the left and right of the terminal output

rows.label: Shimmer
rows.hint: Animation style for working/loading messages

options.label: Classic
options.detail: Soft cosine wave sweeping across the text

options.label: KITT Scanner
options.detail: Knight Rider 1982 red light bouncing left-right

options.label: Disabled
options.detail: No animation; static muted text

rows.label: Pinned Agents
rows.hint: Pinned live-agent jump list above the editor (off hides it; collapsed shows a few rows with an expander; full lists all)

options.label: Off
options.detail: Hide the pinned jump list

options.label: Collapsed
options.detail: Show a few rows with an expander

options.label: Full
options.detail: Always list every live agent

rows.label: Subagent Live Preview
rows.hint: Show each pinned subagent's current (or most recent) tool call beneath its row

rows.label: Smooth Streaming
rows.hint: Reveal assistant text and streamed tool input smoothly while chunks arrive

rows.label: Hide Tool Activity
rows.hint: Hide model-initiated tool calls and results from the transcript

rows.label: Show Token Usage
rows.hint: Show per-turn token usage on assistant messages

rows.label: Show Turn Time
rows.hint: Show the total prompt-to-yield time (including tool calls) on assistant message usage rows

rows.label: Cache Miss Marker
rows.hint: Show a divider after an assistant turn whose request lost (missed) the prompt cache

rows.label: Collapse Compacted History
rows.hint: Collapse pre-compaction history behind the summary divider on the live transcript; disable to keep the full transcript inline with dividers at each compaction point

rows.label: Show Hardware Cursor
rows.hint: Show terminal cursor for IME support

rows.label: IME-Safe Prompt Layout
rows.hint: Move the prompt's bottom border to a separate row so macOS IME preedit cannot displace it

rows.label: Show Resolved Model Badge
rows.hint: Display the actual model ID used by each subagent in the task widget status line

rows.label: Title Icons
rows.hint: Icon and short code that head new generated or /rename session titles

options.label: Nerd Font + Emoji
options.detail: Nerd Font glyph where the Nerd Font symbol preset renders it, else the emoji (default)

options.label: Emoji
options.detail: Always the emoji

options.label: Boring
options.detail: Plain title: no icon or code

rows.label: Show Inline Images
rows.hint: Render images inline in the terminal

rows.label: Auto-Resize Images
rows.hint: Resize large images to 2000x2000 max for better model compatibility

rows.label: Block Images
rows.hint: Prevent images from being sent to LLM providers
